title: 第13章 生死战第14章 我再过分也比你不要脸强
lines: 很是惊讶！
原本已经打算放弃开山掌的林铮，却是重新开始参悟起来。
等以后有机会，看看是否能够得到整套武学。
在塔灵的相助下，林铮算是完善了开山掌的第一掌，虽然只是凡品武学，但掌威相当的霸道。
翌日。
整整参悟了一夜开山掌的林铮，准备继续前往九龙塔，看看是否能够借助九龙塔的力量，来相助自己恢复到巅峰聚灵境。
相差两个阶位，应该不会太难了。
离开洞府。
“清漪？”
“林大哥，你没事吧。”
看着身子单薄的清漪，林铮似乎猜到了什么，问道：“你昨晚没有回去，而是在洞府外站了一夜？”
“我不放心你。”
一声叹息！
将洛清漪紧紧的搂在怀里，林铮很是心疼，这样的女人值得。
“我没事了，你赶快回去休息。”
“真的？”
“放心，我昨天修炼出现些差池，现在已经没事了，不过我需要你的身份令牌。”
洛清漪还是不放心，左看右看，再三确定没事后，才将自己的身份令牌递出去，说道：“我先去找师父，稍后来找你。”
先送走清漪，林铮直接朝着九龙塔的方向走去。
路上，却是被两人阻拦下来。
“萧师兄，我们真的要这样吗？”
萧焰点点头，说道：“虽然他拒绝了火魅长老的拜师，但我们无法确定，他和火魅长老之间到底是什么关系。”
“但他已经重聚气海恢复到聚灵境，我担心不是他的敌手。”
萧焰手里出现一枚丹药，说道：“我偷偷搞到的，一旦无法击败他，立刻吞服丹药，以你现在七重聚灵境修为，可以瞬间提升到九重聚灵境，甚至是巅峰聚灵境，完全可以杀了他。”
“有副作用吗？”
“有，但我会帮你想办法。”
林龙实在不愿意冒险，但他也明白林铮背后有着洛清漪和火魅，拖延时间越久，对自己越是不利。
“林龙，我背后有师父，林铮永远都不敢对付我，但你呢？我是为你好，趁着林铮羽翼未满，正是击杀他的最佳时机。”
“来了。”
看到远处的身影，两人直接走了过去，将其阻拦下来。
“林铮，你杀我二弟，今日我要替林虎报仇，向你发出生死战，你可敢应战。”
“生死战？”
湮鼎宗有着宗规，任何弟子都不得撕下互相残杀，要不然的话，他也不会等到现在，进入湮鼎宗的第一天就报仇了。
林龙冷嘲道：“放心，湮鼎宗有着规定，宗门弟子要是有无法化解的生死恩怨，便可以登上生死台，签生死约，进行生死战。”
“你杀我弟弟，我相信你也想找我报仇，既然如此，那我们就在生死台上决一生死，你可敢。”
萧焰拍了拍林龙的肩膀，嘲讽道：“林龙，我刚刚就和你说过，他肯定不敢应战，好不容易重聚气海，要是在生死台被你杀了怎么办。”
“萧焰，你无需激将我，既然林龙想要生死战，我应战便是。”
“真的？”
林龙手里出现生死约，以指代笔，在生死约上签下名字，随即丢给林铮。
content_en:
Very surprised!
Lin Zheng, who had originally planned to give up on the Mountain Opening Palm, started to understand it again.
Wait for the opportunity in the future to see if you can get the entire set of martial arts.
With the help of the tower spirit, Lin Zheng was able to perfect the first palm of Kaishan Palm. Although he was only an ordinary martial artist, his palm power was quite domineering.
The next day.
Lin Zheng, who had studied the Mountain Opening Palm all night, was ready to continue to the Nine Dragons Tower to see if he could use the power of the Nine Dragons Tower to help him return to the peak spirit gathering state.
There is a difference of two levels, so it shouldn't be too difficult.
Leave the cave.
"Qingyi?"
"Brother Lin, are you okay?"
Looking at the thin Qingyi, Lin Zheng seemed to have guessed something and asked: "You didn't go back last night, but stood outside the cave all night?"
"I don't trust you."
A sigh!
Holding Luo Qingyi tightly in his arms, Lin Zheng felt very distressed. Such a woman was worth it.
"I'm fine, go back and rest quickly."
"Really?"
"Don't worry, I made some mistakes in my practice yesterday, and I'm fine now, but I need your identity token."
Luo Qingyi was still worried. She looked left and right, and after making sure everything was okay, she handed over her identity token and said, "I'll go find the master first, and I'll come back to you later."
"Okay."
After sending Qingyi away first, Lin Zheng walked directly towards the direction of the Kowloon Tower.
On the way, he was stopped by two people.
"Senior Brother Xiao, do we really want this?"
Xiao Yan nodded and said: "Although he rejected Elder Huo Mei's apprenticeship, we are not sure what the relationship between him and Elder Huo Mei is."
"But he has already regrouped his Qi Sea and returned to the Spirit Gathering Realm. I'm worried that he is no match for him."
A pill appeared in Xiao Yan's hand and he said: "I got it secretly. Once you can't defeat him, swallow the pill immediately. With your current seventh-level spirit-gathering realm cultivation, you can instantly upgrade to the ninth-level spirit-gathering realm, or even the peak spirit-gathering realm. You can definitely kill him."
"Are there any side effects?"
"Yes, but I will help you find a way."
Lin Long was really unwilling to take risks, but he also understood that Lin Zheng had Luo Qingyi and Huo Mei behind him. The longer he delayed, the more disadvantageous it would be to him.
"Lin Long, I have a master behind me. Lin Zheng will never dare to deal with me, but what about you? I am doing it for your own good. It is the best time to kill Lin Zheng before his wings are full."
"Coming."
Seeing the figure in the distance, the two people walked over and blocked it.
"Lin Zheng, you killed my second brother. Today I will avenge Lin Hu and challenge you to a life and death fight. Do you dare to accept the fight?"
"A fight to the death?"
The Yanding Sect has sect rules, and no disciples are allowed to tear each other down and kill each other. Otherwise, he would not have waited until now to take revenge on the first day he entered the Yanding Sect.
Lin Long sneered: "Don't worry, the Dioding Sect has regulations. If the disciples of the sect have irresolvable grievances about life and death, they can go up to the life and death platform, sign a life and death contract, and engage in a life and death battle."
"You killed my brother. I believe you also want to seek revenge from me. If that's the case, then we will fight to the death on the stage of life and death. How dare you."
Xiao Yan patted Lin Long on the shoulder and said mockingly: "Lin Long, I just told you that he would definitely not dare to accept the challenge. He finally regained his energy. What if he is killed by you on the stage of life and death?"
"Xiao Yan, you don't need to provoke me. Since Lin Long wants to fight to the death, I will accept the fight."
"Really?"
A life and death contract appeared in Lin Long's hand. He signed the life and death contract with a pen and then threw it to Lin Zheng.
title_en: Chapter 13 Battle of Life and Death Chapter 14 No matter how much I go too far, I am better than you being shameless
